[[File:Marissa Faireborn.png|thumb|220x220px]]
'''Marissa Faireborn''' accompanies the Commander in various [[Story|Missions]]. According to [[Optimus Prime]], she is one of his most valuable allies in the [[EDC Earth Defense Command)|Earth Defense Command]].
She also assists you in the development of your [[Base]] aside of [[Teletraan-I|Teletraan-I]].
